newsitem.title: FRANCE: Council of Europe to help monitor Albania poll.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe to help monitor Albania poll.

text.p: The Council of Europe's foreign ministers confirmed on Tuesday their willingness to help restore democracy in Albania by preparing and observing elections scheduled for next month.

They said the council would cooperate with the European Union and the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe. The elections are aimed at restoring political stability after Albania's collapse into anarchy earlier this year.
Earlier, leaders in the council's parliamentary assembly appealed to political parties in the Balkan nation to settle their differences to clear the way for polls on June 29.

They recommended a series of electoral reforms including greater proportionality, abolition of a ban on candidates from the former communist government and the disbanding of rebel committees still running some parts of the country.
The 40-member Council of Europe was set up after World War Two to foster democracy and human rights across the continent.
